name: jevscout
description: Condenses large MCP results with Jev before they fill Claude Code's context. Relevant parts stay verbatim, and the full result stays recoverable.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Lets Jev rank large MCP results. Stored in your system's credential store, not in settings files. Leave it empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment Claude Code starts in.
